mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status FROM admin_role r INNER JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.admin_id = #{adminId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND ur.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.id ASC
SELECT id, role_code, role_name, status FROM admin_role WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user_role SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user_role (admin_id, role_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{roleId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = 0
